Class JwtService

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.common.security.JwtService
@Service public class JwtService extends Object
Service for generating and validating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs). Provides methods to generate JWT tokens, retrieve their expiration time, and parse and validate them.
